creditCensus.scope: Individual credits of at least one wNEAR have complete terminal cursor chains over the entire pinned study. The smaller-credit total equals independently reconciled all-credit gross less those individually enumerated credits. Where sender histories have closed, incoming event counts are calculated from published account transfer-event totals minus explicitly enumerated debit events. The smaller received entries have not been individually enumerated across the entire period.

chronology.method: The earliest stablecoin debit exhausted the entire opening balance before the first verified incoming payment. Every subsequent USDT debit therefore spent swap-linked payments. The complete wNEAR ledger and separate pinned verifier state calls show that each native delivery emptied the entire collector wNEAR stock. Each delivery necessarily included all identified purchases since the preceding zero balance; the last identified purchase occurred after the fourth delivery.

indexedAcquisitions.scope: FastNear Explorer raw historical transaction and receipt index. All listed collector exchanges and swap-linked transfers are checked against successful receipt logs and signed instructions. The comparison fields identify the subset also reproduced from independent archival RPC or finalized full blocks.

expandedAcquisitions.scope: Counts include only independently signed collector exchanges or executed directed transfers in the frozen receipt union. Direct archival evidence supplements the raw historical Explorer index. All three collectors’ indexed gross wNEAR debits match the successful native deliveries. Closing inventory is assigned entirely to identified acquisitions before reporting a recipient-specific lower bound. Unclassified gross credits remain a quantity, with no assumed funding source or economic type. Neither gross exchanges nor treasury custody establish external cash earnings, incremental market demand or a native burn.

priorityCohort.scope: These are the 2,000 eligible previously unseen transaction hashes with the largest aggregate individual credits of at least one wNEAR at the declared reference time. The rest of the frozen release also includes qualifying evidence captured independently.

intermediary.interpretation: The complete bidirectional transfer window identifies the DAO credit and subsequent withdrawal debit. The entire opening intermediate stock is allowed as alternate funding. This is a re-routing of already-owned group inventory to the stated extent despite an intents.near native receipt predecessor.

nativeAdjustments.scope: Consolidated three-wallet native balance change from 1 September through 30 October 2026. Zero net difference does not exclude offsetting unmeasured flows. Protocol execution credits are separate from external user fees.

treasuryControl.scope: Direct archival contract views and access-key lists at one pinned block. They establish the returned permissions, not independent controller identities, immutable policy, reviewed deployed code, or legal rights of token holders.

cohort.scope: The full candidate population is defined by positive transfers returned by the NearBlocks account index in a predeclared ten-minute interval. Membership needs a successful finalized verifier token_diff with a positive fee, matching account and intent in intents_executed, and an actual same-asset credit to the configured protocol collector in the same receipt. Recurrence is a distinct qualifying fee in each stated calendar window. A negative observation is scoped to paginated public index coverage; unresolved histories stay unknown. This is a baseline of active signers, not first-acquisition cohorts, end customer identity, profit or continuous usage. Solver, collection, transaction-specific and other intermediary accounts may participate.

allocation.scope: One qualifying fee witness per baseline signer, not all its trades or a protocol take-rate estimate. Transfers require the same executed account and intent hash as the charge. Ratios require an independently verified NEP-413 implicit signature, exhaustively understood signed debits, a spent input asset with no positive trade leg or withdrawal of the same asset, and all other same-asset transfer debits in the denominator. The entire actual ledger debit for the asset must equal the signed denominator, with no credit of that asset to the signer in the receipt. Blank ratios are unavailable, not zero. Transfer purpose and partner cash entitlements remain unassigned.

destinations.scope: One qualifying August 1 baseline witness per signer. Only independently verified implicit NEP-413 signatures, matching executed FT withdrawal events and same-amount internal withdrawal burns qualify. OMFT destinations require exact token contract and identical memo address. Omni Bridge destinations require an exact chain-prefixed recipient. Digest is SHA-256 of the JSON tuple [format, scope, exact-case address]. An instruction is not proof of payout completion on its destination chain or control of that address by a customer.
